Flat Earth Eclipse

A real total or annular eclipse, replayed on the azimuthal-equidistant disc with a small sun circling overhead. The umbra positions are real; the object casting them is reconstructed.

Eclipse

Model

The object must sit on the line from the sun to the umbra. The umbra's width alone allows any height, as long as the size fits. The width of the partial-eclipse zone (penumbra) adds a second condition, which fixes both. Untick the box to choose the height yourself.

Display

Sun and its path during the eclipse Object and its path Umbra track (real central line) With "True sizes" on, the sun, object and umbra are drawn at their real diameter. Rings mark them so they stay findable when zoomed out. Zoom in to compare.
